prereg.idea: heavy volume on the 1h and 15m bars comes before up-moves worth buying calls for
prereg.entry: buy the ATM call at the 1h close on the first bar of each volume_surge signal
prereg.exit: sell when price turns 0.75 day-ATR off its best point since entry, or at expiry
prereg.measure: median option multiple, % doubled and % lost half for signal entries vs all bars, in each half
prereg.pass_mark: signal median multiple at least 1.2x the all-bars median in both halves
prereg.label: C_1x
